episodeTitle: Most English errors are the same ten

prompt.en: Match each common error to its correct form.
prompt.hi: हर आम ग़लती को उसके सही रूप से मिलाइए।

a.en: We will discuss about the plan.
a.hi: We will discuss about the plan.

a.en: One of my friend is here.
a.hi: One of my friend is here.

b.en: One of my friends is here.
b.hi: One of my friends is here.

a.en: She can't cope up with the work.
a.hi: She can't cope up with the work.

b.en: She can't cope with the work.
b.hi: She can't cope with the work.

a.en: Each of the students have a pen.
a.hi: Each of the students have a pen.

b.en: Each of the students has a pen.
b.hi: Each of the students has a pen.

takeaway.en: Most marks lost in Paper B come from the same few slips: extra words (about, back, up), 'one of' with a singular, and 'each' with a plural verb.
takeaway.hi: पेपर B में ज़्यादातर अंक इन्हीं कुछ ग़लतियों से कटते हैं: फ़ालतू शब्द (about, back, up), 'one of' के साथ एकवचन, और 'each' के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया।

sources: Wren and Martin, High School English Grammar and Composition
Oxford Learner's Dictionaries, usage notes for 'discuss', 'return', 'cope' (oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com)
